author: root independent model reviewer
prior_exposure: Root read the original r9 contract/schema and created the frozen real-source inpatient assembly. Producer implementation-plan summaries were read; no new module/schema/test source or candidate verdict file has been opened. This is independent capability review, not a blind original-source study.

cases.source_or_contract_requirement: A complete finite varying schedule is supported by existing contract design.
Amounts375 and375.00 differ only in decimal representation.
Two completely supported conditional unbounded bands with the same complete source meaning can agree mechanically; this grants no source acceptance.
Explicit conditional unbounded end and finite999 cannot automatically agree.
Source endpoint not stated does not establish an unbounded endpoint.
Unknown endpoint, including equal unknown endpoints, cannot agree.
A bare null endpoint is incomplete, not infinity.
An unbounded end without its explicit covered-stay rule cannot be ready.
An unbounded rule must bind the relevant covered_days condition, evidence and review references.
Different covered-stay predicates are material even when both endpoints are unbounded.
Unknown coverage predicate cannot pass merely because endpoint kind says unbounded.
An unbounded end cannot precede another band.
Omitting the later zero-cost band cannot agree with the full schedule.
A silent uncovered day gap cannot be converted into a complete continuous schedule.
Overlapping bands are invalid.
A finite end before begin is invalid.
Boolean day endpoints/beginnings are not integer days.
Changed later-band monetary amount is material.
NaN or infinite monetary values cannot be ready.
Daily charge versus per-stay charge is material.
An otherwise complete opposite-network observation cannot agree.
USD and percentage are distinct units.
Each admission versus a Medicare benefit-period reset is material.
A partial first-band scalar anchor cannot masquerade as a complete schedule even with other fields populated.
Complete-schedule scope and its evidence/review bindings cannot be absent.
Native1a and separate1a1 observations do not become the same service from numeric correspondence.
Every existing material condition-family gate remains enforced.
Missing exact source evidence/locator/footnote or review references remains incomplete.
Wrong year/plan/segment or pinned expected identity cannot be excused by an endpoint model.
Matching uninterpreted source scope markers cannot agree.
A mapping ID without complete exact-pair review registry support cannot excuse a difference.
Every mechanical result keeps accepted_for_reference false.
